answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: the flag existed only because the singleton loser exited 3 and a transient unit that exits NONZERO stays loaded in `failed` state and blocks its own name (superclaude lines ~553-559, measured 2026-08-18). Since b38af5fd1852 (35711160e) the loser exits 0, and a unit that exits ZERO is garbage-collected and frees its name, so the flag has no remaining job. Not assumed: that no other unit launched through _sc_loop_start relies on it; the web-server unit (line ~711) does not carry it. The orchestrator's reason is also load-bearing: with the flag in, a loser that regresses to the loud exit 3 reads as a success, which is how a stale flag hides exactly the regression b38af5fd1852 removed.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: the file and exact lines (superclaude 5, 524, 553-559, 595-596, 636, 672, 689), that line 636 `-p SuccessExitStatus=3 \` is deleted and the comments rewritten to 'a loser exits 0 quietly', the three charter fields, and the proof's two teeth (extract the _sc_loop_start function text; assert no SuccessExitStatus in it; assert no 'loser exits 3' anywhere in the file). The ticket carries all of these.

answers.collision_check: Looked at b38af5fd1852 (the loser exits 0; its bounds left superclaude out), 64db27776707 (arm 4 of the recovery survival proof; independent of this) and the web-server unit in the same file (no SuccessExitStatus; line ~700 comment says so). No collision. The flag's removal changes what a loud exit 3 looks like (failed, name blocked), which is the signal wanted, and reset-failed on the retry path already handles a wedged name.
answers.falsifier_check: Clauses: (1) the launcher's ground-loop unit start (_sc_loop_start) no longer passes -p SuccessExitStatus=3 | (2) superclaude no longer says the ground loop's singleton loser exits 3, in comments or in its log lines. Horizon: both red on current main (the flag and the comments are there), green after, and red again on a hollow build with the flag restored; the proof reads the launcher's text, so it runs on any OS.

It states the flag and 'the singleton loser exits 3 BY DESIGN' in three fields (superclaude/ground_loop_spawn: shape, why_SuccessExitStatus_3_is_not_optional, why_reset_failed_moved_to_the_retry), and those would contradict the launcher after this change (Law 5: the thing and its story may never contradict).
